title: Psalm 6
opening_line: LORD, in thy wrath rebuke me not;

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: LORD, in thy wrath rebuke me not;
text.normalized: LORD, in thy wrath rebuke me not;
text.reading: LORD, in thy wrath rebuke me not;

text.diplomatic: Nor in thy hot rage chasten me.
text.normalized: Nor in thy hot rage chasten me.
text.reading: Nor in thy hot rage chasten me.

text.diplomatic: LORD, pity me, for I am weak:
text.normalized: LORD, pity me, for I am weak:
text.reading: LORD, pity me, for I am weak:

text.diplomatic: Heal me, for my bones vexèd be.
text.normalized: Heal me, for my bones vexèd be.
text.reading: Heal me, for my bones vexèd be.

text.diplomatic: My soul is also vexèd sore;
text.normalized: My soul is also vexèd sore;
text.reading: My soul is also vexèd sore;

text.diplomatic: But, LORD, how long stay wilt thou make?
text.normalized: But, LORD, how long stay wilt thou make?
text.reading: But, LORD, how long stay wilt thou make?

text.diplomatic: Return, O LORD, my soul set free;
text.normalized: Return, O LORD, my soul set free;
text.reading: Return, O LORD, my soul set free;

text.diplomatic: O save me, for thy mercies’ sake.
text.normalized: O save me, for thy mercies’ sake.
text.reading: O save me, for thy mercies’ sake.

text.diplomatic: Because those that deceasèd are
text.normalized: Because those that deceasèd are
text.reading: Because those that deceasèd are

text.diplomatic: Of thee shall no remembrance have;
text.normalized: Of thee shall no remembrance have;
text.reading: Of thee shall no remembrance have;

text.diplomatic: And who is he that will to thee
text.normalized: And who is he that will to thee
text.reading: And who is he that will to thee

text.diplomatic: Give praises lying in the grave?
text.normalized: Give praises lying in the grave?
text.reading: Give praises lying in the grave?

text.diplomatic: I with my groaning weary am,
text.normalized: I with my groaning weary am,
text.reading: I with my groaning weary am,

text.diplomatic: I also all the night my bed
text.normalized: I also all the night my bed
text.reading: I also all the night my bed

text.diplomatic: Have causèd for to swim; and I
text.normalized: Have causèd for to swim; and I
text.reading: Have causèd for to swim; and I

text.diplomatic: With tears my couch have waterèd.
text.normalized: With tears my couch have waterèd.
text.reading: With tears my couch have waterèd.

text.diplomatic: Mine eye, consumed with grief, grows old,
text.normalized: Mine eye, consumed with grief, grows old,
text.reading: Mine eye, consumed with grief, grows old,

text.diplomatic: Because of all mine enemies.
text.normalized: Because of all mine enemies.
text.reading: Because of all mine enemies.

text.diplomatic: Hence from me, wicked workers all;
text.normalized: Hence from me, wicked workers all;
text.reading: Hence from me, wicked workers all;

text.diplomatic: For GOD hath heard my weeping cries.
text.normalized: For GOD hath heard my weeping cries.
text.reading: For GOD hath heard my weeping cries.

text.diplomatic: GOD hath my supplication heard,
text.normalized: GOD hath my supplication heard,
text.reading: GOD hath my supplication heard,

text.diplomatic: My prayer receivèd graciously.
text.normalized: My prayer receivèd graciously.
text.reading: My prayer receivèd graciously.

text.diplomatic: Shamed and sore vexed be all my foes,
text.normalized: Shamed and sore vexed be all my foes,
text.reading: Shamed and sore vexed be all my foes,

text.diplomatic: Shamed and back turnèd suddenly.
text.normalized: Shamed and back turnèd suddenly.
text.reading: Shamed and back turnèd suddenly.
